title: Carb entry in AAPS that I cannot find the source
body: - **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused the problem: 11:45 PM US Central Standard Time June 4, 2026 - Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the upper-right corner). Build: 5b1a2fec02-2026.05.30 flavor: fullrelease Nighscout version 15.0.3 Firstly, I am very new to AAPS, so I really sorry if this is operator error.... and I am wasting your time! I am on objective 4. So open loop. I was checking my logs in AAPS this morning from last night to see what it was doing. I noticed a carb entry at 11:45pm for 25g. I was fast asleep and didn't place those carbs in the app. My sleep tracker confirms I was asleep. I can also see the carb entry in NS. I do not see any reference to 25 g of carbs in my AAPS logs. So, where did they come from? Carb sync from Nightscout is turned off. I confirmed with my sleep log that I was indeed asleep. I have attached screenshots, logs, etc.

comments.body: locate logs at least few hours before and after
you must locate relevant files in phone
